content.short: Xociety provides cutting-edge infrastructure for web3 games, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: XOCIETY is a sci-fi metaverse and Web3 gaming project featuring an immersive economy and shooter mechanics. As a prominent player in the Decentralized Games space, Xociety specializes in delivering high-quality web3 games infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Sui, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, Xociety focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
content.meta: Xociety is redefining web3 games on Sui. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Xociety directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
